title: LionOPGuard
description: Logs all OP commands to prevent and catch admin abuse.
body:
Keep your server safe from admin abuse with OP Guard. This plugin logs all OP commands into a discord channel, allowing you to catch admin abuse with ease before it is too late. 
COMMANDS:
- /opguard-toggle - Turns the plugin on and off.
- /opguard-reload - Reloads the server config.

PERMS:
- opguard.admin - Allows you to use the commands.
